[SWS_CRYPT_02418] Truncation of hash value
⌈
The functions Veri-
fyPreHashed and SignPreHashed shall truncate the provided hash value, if the
bitlength of the provided hash value is larger than bitlength used for signing/verification
and if the applied algorithm according to the AlgId allows the use of a hash-value with
the provided bitlength and specifies a truncation.
⌋
